description: Fork of exp071 (1.7088 @ 8K, leak fix) applying sparse_scatter only to out_proj as a clean nap<->n_sparse trade: nap 6 -> 10 (table_dim 64 -> 1024, 16x larger), n_sparse_outputs = 96/16 = 6 (1/16 of n_outputs=E=96). Out_proj LUT weight count unchanged (1*tph*1024*6 = 1*tph*64*96 per layer). qk_joint and v_lut are unchanged from exp071 (no sparse_scatter, orig nap/tph). Tests whether bigger tables with sparse output projection wins out_proj over smaller tables with full output, at constant weight.
